meta.dataset_description: Combined Cleveland / Hungary / Switzerland heart-disease cohort (1,190 patients). Clinical predictors: age, sex, chest-pain type, resting blood pressure, cholesterol, fasting blood sugar, resting ECG, maximum heart rate, exercise angina, oldpeak and ST slope. Target 1 = heart disease present. Cholesterol = 0 and blood pressure = 0 are placeholder codes, not measurements.

contradictions.description: Domain rules that detect logically / biologically contradictory records (e.g. blood pressure = 0, cholesterol = 0, p-tau > total tau, class 'no alcohol' with a positive alcohol measurement). Flagged values are reported raw and are excluded from later statistics.

rules.label: Cholesterol = 0
rules.description: Total cholesterol of 0 mg/dL is physiologically impossible. In this dataset 0 is a placeholder for a missing lipid panel.

rules.label: Negative ST depression
rules.description: oldpeak (ST depression induced by exercise) cannot be negative.

rules.label: Blood pressure = 0
rules.description: A resting blood pressure of 0 mmHg is incompatible with life: the value is a missing/placeholder code, not a measurement.

rules.label: Impossible cholesterol
rules.description: Cholesterol outside 100-650 mg/dL (0 is reported separately).

rules.label: Invalid ST slope code
rules.description: ST slope must be 1 (up), 2 (flat) or 3 (down); 0 is an invalid code.

rules.label: Impossible resting blood pressure
rules.description: Resting blood pressure outside 70-250 mmHg (0 is reported separately).

rules.label: Impossible maximum heart rate
rules.description: Maximum heart rate outside 60-220 bpm (0 is a missing code).

rules.label: Invalid categorical codes
rules.description: Coded clinical variables outside their documented code lists (sex 0/1, chest pain 1-4, fasting sugar 0/1, resting ECG 0-2, exercise angina 0/1, target 0/1).

272 exact duplicate rows (22.86%). They can inflate correlations and cross-validation scores; drop_duplicates() is recommended unless they are genuine repeated measurements.
Hidden missing data: 'resting bp s' has 1 zero(s) (0.1%) while the valid range is (70.0, 250.0). These zeros are placeholders, not measurements.

noise.description: Noise-to-signal analysis for tabular data: local k-NN residual noise divided by the robust signal spread, SNR(dB), Hampel spikes, repeated readings and out-of-range values. Each feature receives a verdict.

method.noise_to_signal: Robust sigma of the residual between each reading and the median of its 8 nearest neighbours in standardised feature space, divided by the robust sigma of the feature. 0 = perfectly predictable / smooth, 1 = as large as the signal itself. This is the tabular adaptation of the weather second-difference NSR (row order is meaningless in these tables).
method.snr_db: 10*log10(signal variance / noise variance); > 20 dB is very clean, < 5 dB is noisy.
method.spikes: Residual larger than 3.5 robust sigmas and 40% of the signal spread.
method.stuck_sensor: >= 10 identical consecutive readings on a continuous feature.
method.out_of_range: Values outside the biological / physical range; masked before stats.

noise_reasons: moderate local random fluctuation (NSR 20.0% of signal spread)
moderate local random fluctuation (NSR 22.7% of signal spread)
many isolated spikes (12.52%) despite a low overall NSR

insights: Noise-to-signal is estimated from a local k-NN smoother in feature space (k=8), because these tables are not time series: row order is arbitrary, so the weather second-difference formula would measure row order.
Moderate/high random noise in 3 feature(s): ['resting bp s', 'cholesterol', 'oldpeak'].
Data-integrity problems in 3 feature(s): ['resting bp s', 'cholesterol', 'oldpeak'].
'resting bp s': 1 values outside the physical range (70.0, 250.0)
'cholesterol': 172 values outside the physical range (50.0, 650.0)
'oldpeak': 13 values outside the physical range (-0.01, 7.0)
Noisiest: 'cholesterol' (NSR 0.23, SNR 12.64 dB); cleanest: 'oldpeak' (NSR 0.08).
Clean features: ['age', 'max heart rate'].

outliers.description: Classical univariate methods (IQR fences, Z-score, modified Z-score / MAD, 1-99% percentile) plus a consensus of six unsupervised multivariate detectors (Isolation Forest, One-Class SVM, LOF, Elliptic Envelope, DBSCAN, robust Mahalanobis).

machine_learning_outliers.consensus_rule: flagged by at least 3 of 6 detectors

insights: Most outlier-prone feature (IQR): 'resting bp s' (36 points, 3.03%).

Elliptic Envelope: 60 anomalies (5.04%).

Mahalanobis: 60 anomalies (5.04%).

model_phase.description: Model phase: target balance, sklearn Pipeline + ColumnTransformer, Random Forest on a stratified hold-out with 5-fold cross-validation, confusion matrix, and impurity / permutation / mutual-information feature importances.

preprocessing.pipeline: Median imputation + StandardScaler (numeric); most-frequent imputation + OneHotEncoder (categorical).

insights: Target 'target': {'1': 629, '0': 561} (balanced, ratio 1.12:1).
Hold-out: balanced accuracy 0.924, macro F1 0.923, accuracy 0.923 (majority baseline 0.530); ROC-AUC 0.973; 5-fold CV balanced accuracy 0.926 +/- 0.012.
Top impurity predictors: [('ST slope', 18.4), ('chest pain type', 12.67), ('oldpeak', 12.1), ('max heart rate', 11.64), ('age', 9.89)].
Top permutation impact: 'ST slope' (15.22 points of balanced accuracy).
Top mutual-information features: [('ST slope', 0.18295), ('chest pain type', 0.15262), ('max heart rate', 0.12613), ('exercise angina', 0.11689), ('cholesterol', 0.11609)].

interpretation.description: Interpretation of the EDA results and the concrete actions to apply from the data description: what to fix, what to mask, what to keep for modelling, and which checks are already active in the Pipeline.
interpretation.summary: Quality score: 87.6/100 (moderate). 175 contradictory rows (14.706%) across 5 triggered rule(s). Hidden missing values: 'cholesterol' has 172 zero placeholder(s). 3 feature(s) show noise (60.0% of those tested); mean noise-to-signal 0.1809.

recommendations.action: Correct the source values where possible; otherwise keep them masked as missing and document the domain rule that was violated.
Drop exact duplicates before cross-validation unless they are genuine repeated measurements; otherwise scores become optimistic.

recommendations.finding: 'cholesterol' contains 172 zeros where zero is not a valid measurement.
recommendations.action: Re-code these zeros as NaN before imputation; never let a placeholder enter scaling, correlation or model training.

recommendations.finding: 60.0% of tested features are flagged as noisy.
recommendations.action: Review the measurement protocol for the highest-NSR features; aggregate repeated readings or apply smoothing, and prefer robust scaling/tree models.

recommendations.finding: 187 value(s) outside the physical range were masked.
recommendations.action: Add the same range checks to the ingestion step and reject/log invalid readings instead of silently accepting them.
Inspect them with the domain expert; use robust models or winsorisation only when extremes are confirmed to be measurement errors.

recommendations.finding: 'ST slope' is the strongest impurity driver; permutation top is 'ST slope'.
recommendations.action: Retain the top drivers but confirm they are available at prediction time; drop features whose permutation importance is near zero.
